source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Highlight the critical non-compliance issues.
3. Provide detailed notes on each violation.
4. Include photographs of violations when available.
5. Document witness statements if applicable.
6. Record the auditor's reasoning behind the "failed" rating.
7. Note the remediation actions required by the auditor.
8. Keep track of the deadlines for corrective actions.
9. Summarize the audit process and its outcomes.
10. Keep originals and copies of all documents securely stored.
11. Invite feedback from the audited party for accuracy.
12. Include a summary of the communication between the auditor and the audited party.
13. Record any follow-up actions or subsequent audits planned.
14. Ensure the report is signed and dated by appropriate personnel.
15. Include an executive summary and conclusions at the beginning of the report.<|end_of_text|>
